items.description: In what is entirely in line with rumors that have been swirling fairly persistently, AMD appears to have settled on Samsung's chip fabrication arm to produce its next-gen 2nm CPUs, Venice and Verano, as per the outlines of a fresh speculative reverie, this time from Daishin Securities. AMD best fits
items.tldr: TL;DR: AMDが次世代2nm CPU「Venice」と「Verano」の製造をSamsung Foundryに発注したと報じられ、北米のファブレス顧客としてAMDが特定されました。

items.title: NVIDIA Squashes Vera Rubin Rumors, First Shipments Rolling Out In July To Major AI Customers With Mass Production In 2H 26
items.description: NVIDIA has accelerated the rollout of its next-gen AI powerhouse, Vera Rubin, with first shipments commencing as early as July this year. Despite Rumors of Design Issues, NVIDIA is pushing ahead with a spectacular Vera Rubin Launch, The Center of Next-Gen AI A few days ago, we reported a few rumors
items.tldr: NVIDIAは次世代AIプロセッサ「Vera Rubin」の出荷を7月から開始し、2026年下半期には大量生産に入る予定であると発表した。設計上の問題に関する噂がある中でも、同社はVera Rubinのローンチを進めている。

items.title: NVIDIA’s V100, An 8-Year Old GPU, Now Sells for $100 and Crushes Modern Consumer Cards in AI LLM Workloads
items.description: New GPUs are optimized substantially for AI workloads, but what if old GPUs like the 8-year-old NVIDIA V100, costing around $100, start to outperform recent offerings in LLMs? NVIDIA V100, an 8-Year-Old GPU, Dusted The 5-Year Old RTX 3060 & 3-Year Old RX 7800 XT With Better Performance & Eff
items.tldr: 8年前のNVIDIA V100が約100ドルで販売されており、最新のコンシューマーカードよりもAI LLMワークロードにおいて優れた性能を発揮している。

items.title: ‘Your Career Starts at the Beginning of the AI Revolution,’ NVIDIA CEO Tells Graduates
items.description: “You are entering the world at an extraordinary moment,” NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang told graduates as he delivered the keynote address at Carnegie Mellon University’s 128th commencement ceremony on Sunday. “A new industry is being born. A new era of science and discovery is beginning.
items.tldr: NVIDIAのCEO、ジェンセン・ファンはカーネギーメロン大学の卒業式で、AI革命の始まりに卒業生が立ち会っていることを強調し、新しい産業と科学の時代が始まっていると伝えました。

items.title: Silicon Motion CEO Warns Memory & SSD Shortages Will Drag Into 2028 as AI Firms Lock Up Supply Through Long-Term Contracts
items.description: Silicon Motion's CEO has said that memory (DRAM) and SSD (NAND) shortages would last until 2028 due to the continued demand from AI firms. Memory & SSD Shortages Are So Bad That They Are Expected To Last Till 2028, And Prices Are Expected To Continue To Climb We know that memory and SSD shortage
items.tldr: Silicon MotionのCEOは、AI企業による長期契約の影響で、DRAMおよびNANDの不足が2028年まで続くと警告しています。価格の上昇も予想されています。

items.title: SMIC Founder Says It’s A “Misconception” That Semiconductor Success Is “Only Achieved When 3nm Or 2nm Is Reached” In New Interview
items.description: TSMC’s success in the semiconductor industry is primarily due to the manufacturer’s unyielding focus on its advanced processes and ability to achieve stability in record time, allowing the company to form long-term business relationships with trillion-dollar firms like Apple and NVIDIA. While being
items.tldr: SMICの創業者は、半導体の成功は「3nmや2nmに達したときだけに達成される」という考えは誤解であると述べ、TSMCの成功は先進的なプロセスへの集中と迅速な安定性の確保にあると強調した。

items.title: Intel’s Lip-Bu Tan Teases “Exciting New Products” With NVIDIA as He Hoods Jensen Huang at Carnegie Mellon Doctorate Ceremony
items.description: Intel's CEO, Lip-Bu Tan, has congratulated NVIDIA's CEO, Jensen Huang, on his Honorary Doctorate in Science and Technology, while working together on "exciting new products". Intel & NVIDIA's Journey Has Just Begun, & The World Will Soon See "Exciting New Product" Collabs Between The Tech Gi
items.tldr: IntelのCEO、Lip-Bu Tanは、NVIDIAのCEO、Jensen Huangの名誉博士号受賞を祝うとともに、両社が協力して「エキサイティングな新製品」を発表することを示唆しました。

items.title: A Customer Nabs An M4 Max MacBook Pro With A Terrific Configuration From A Pawn Shop Of All Places, For Just $1,501
items.description: Apple’s M5 Max is currently the company’s top-end SoC to be found in the MacBook Pro, but there’s no universe in which the M4 Max would be considered diminished in any way because it’s still a ridiculously powerful SoC, and a downright expensive one at that. Naturally, any portable Mac featuring the
items.tldr: 顧客が質屋で驚くべき構成のM4 Max MacBook Proを1,501ドルで手に入れた。M4 Maxは依然として非常に強力なSoCであり、Appleの最新のM5 Maxに劣ることはない。

items.title: Apple’s visionOS Job Listings Don’t Indicate The Vision Pro’s Success, As Company Is Working On Incredible Advancements In Same Segment
items.description: There is a torrent of jobs available for Apple’s visionOS platform, which may hint that the California-based giant is going through an aggressive hiring spree since there’s incredible demand for the Vision Pro. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman didn’t believe this was the case and, as a result, was receiving
items.tldr: AppleはvisionOSプラットフォームに多くの求人を出しており、Vision Proの需要が高まっている可能性があるが、Bloombergのマーク・ガーマンはその成功を疑問視している。

items.title: Apple’s Base M5 Pro MacBook Pro With 24GB Unified RAM Breaks Another Discount Record On Amazon, Now $215 On The Space Black Color
items.description: The M5 Pro is a fantastic chipset upgrade for those who want to migrate from Windows or those who believe that their older Apple Silicon is no longer the performer that it used to be. Fortunately, you get to pocket incredible savings on the powerful 14-inch MacBook Pro featuring this chipset because
items.tldr: AppleのM5 Proチップを搭載した14インチMacBook Proが、Amazonでスペースブラックカラーが215ドルの割引価格で販売されており、Windowsからの移行や古いApple Siliconの性能に不満を持つユーザーにとって魅力的な選択肢となっています。

items.title: AMD's excellent Radeon RX 9070 with 16 GB of VRAM hits all-time low pricing — PowerColor Hellhound variant is 23% off list price
items.description: If you've been looking for a GPU upgrade but were disappointed by the ongoing market conditions, a small window of opportunity has just sprung open. AMD's fantastic RX 9070 is on sale for just $554, discounted $165 from its typical retail price. It's a very capable 1440p card that can even game at 4
items.tldr: AMDのRadeon RX 9070が通常価格から165ドル引きの554ドルで販売されており、特に1440pゲームに優れた性能を発揮するグラフィックカードとして注目されています。

items.title: MIT researchers revive 40-year-old triangular zipper concept now made possible by 3D printing, creates shape-shifting robots and deployable structures — 3D-printed 'Y-Zipper' turns floppy tentacles into rigid beams in seconds
items.description: MIT researchers have developed a 3D-printed three-sided zipper that rapidly transforms floppy structures into rigid beams, robotic limbs, and deployable frameworks using triangular geometry.
items.tldr: MITの研究者が、三角形のジッパーを3Dプリント技術で復活させ、柔軟な構造を瞬時に剛性のあるビームやロボットの肢体、展開可能なフレームに変形させることに成功しました。

items.title: The Case For Compilers: A Look at SPEC CPU 2026 on LLVM 22
items.description: Looking at the role of compilers in SPEC CPU 2026 performance, we have tested the benchmark suite on LLVM 22. The newest compiler provides a meaningful improvement to benchmark scores for multiple architectures The post The Case For Compilers: A Look at SPEC CPU 2026 on LLVM 22 appeared first on Ser
items.tldr: SPEC CPU 2026のパフォーマンスにおけるコンパイラの役割を検証した結果、LLVM 22を使用することで複数のアーキテクチャにおいてベンチマークスコアが有意に向上することが確認されました。

items.title: Former Epic director is building a European rival to the Unreal and Unity game engines — 'The Immense Engine' dev sees opportunity for AI agents to 'do the work of ten or fifteen people'
items.description: A heavyweight games industry veteran says he is building a fully European alternative to popular games engines from American and Chinese companies.
items.tldr: 元Epicのディレクターが、アメリカや中国のゲームエンジンに対抗する完全なヨーロッパ製ゲームエンジン「The Immense Engine」を開発中で、AIエージェントを活用して作業効率を大幅に向上させる機会を見出しています。

items.title: China's Hanyuan-2 debuts as 'world's first' dual-core quantum computer — 200-qubit claims incredible power efficiency, but lacks critical performance benchmarks
items.description: CAS Cold Atom Technology, a Wuhan-based firm affiliated with the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS), unveiled what it calls the world's first dual-core quantum computer.
items.tldr: 中国のCAS Cold Atom Technologyが、世界初のデュアルコア量子コンピュータ「Hanyuan-2」を発表したが、200キュービットの高効率を謳う一方で、重要な性能指標が欠けている。

items.title: 3DMakerPro Toucan 3D Scanner review: All-in-one 3D scanning
items.description: Designed to be used as a standalone device, the 3DMakerPro Toucan allows users to capture a point cloud, generate a 3D model, and export it without using a computer. The hardware has a premium feel, and the Class 3R laser can create detailed point clouds quickly. However, the software lacks polish a
items.tldr: TL;DR: 3DMakerPro Toucanはスタンドアロンで使用できる3Dスキャナーで、ポイントクラウドをキャプチャし3Dモデルを生成・エクスポート可能だが、ソフトウェアの完成度は低い。

items.title: AI data center project secretly sucked 29 million gallons of water over 15 months before detected by residents complaining about low water pressure — officials refuse to fine builders of massive 6.2 million-square-foot facility over unauthorized water use
items.description: QTS says the extra 29 million gallons were consumed during temporary construction activities, including concrete work, dust control, and site preparation.
items.tldr: AIデータセンターの建設プロジェクトが、住民からの水圧低下の苦情が出るまでの15ヶ月間にわたり、2900万ガロンの水を無断で使用していたが、当局は建設業者に対して罰金を科さない方針を示した。

items.title: Tiny credit card computer includes eInk screen and is just 1mm thick — Muxcard is powered by the ESP32-C3 microcontroller
items.description: A GitHub project shares details of the prototype for 'a fully working computer that is literally the size of a credit card,' dubbed the Muxcard
items.tldr: TL;DR: Muxcardは、ESP32-C3マイクロコントローラーを搭載し、クレジットカードサイズで厚さ1mmのeInkスクリーンを備えた完全に動作するコンピュータのプロトタイプです。

items.title: AMD's legendary K5, its first independently-designed processor, is being removed from the Linux kernel — 4.3-million-transistor chip gets the axe because it lacks Time Stamp Counter (TSC) support, making it a coding burden
items.description: AMD’s landmark K5 processor family will no longer be supported by Linux when kernel version 7.2 arrives.
items.tldr: AMDの初の独自設計プロセッサK5が、Time Stamp Counter (TSC) サポートがないため、Linuxカーネル7.2から削除されることが決定した。

items.title: Hackers abuse Google ads, Claude.ai chats to push Mac malware
items.description: Attackers are abusing Google Ads and legitimate Claude.ai shared chats in an active malvertising campaign. Users searching for "Claude mac download" may come across sponsored search results that list claude.ai as the target website, but lead to instructions that install malware on their Mac. [...]
items.tldr: 攻撃者がGoogle AdsとClaude.aiのチャットを悪用し、Mac向けのマルウェアを配布するマルバタイジングキャンペーンを展開している。ユーザーが「Claude mac download」を検索すると、実際にはマルウェアをインストールする指示が含まれた偽の結果が表示される可能性がある。

items.title: Police shut down reboot of Crimenetwork marketplace, arrest admin
items.description: German authorities have shut down a relaunch version of the criminal marketplace 'Crimenetwork' that generated more than 3.6 million euros, and arrested its operator. [...]
items.tldr: ドイツ当局は、360万ユーロ以上を生み出した犯罪マーケットプレイス「Crimenetwork」の再起動版を閉鎖し、その運営者を逮捕しました。

items.title: Ollama Out-of-Bounds Read Vulnerability Allows Remote Process Memory Leak
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed a critical security vulnerability in Ollama that, if successfully exploited, could allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to leak its entire process memory. The out-of-bounds read flaw, which likely impacts over 300,000 servers globally, is tracked as CVE-2
items.tldr: Ollamaにおける重大なセキュリティ脆弱性が発表され、リモートの未認証攻撃者がプロセスメモリを漏洩させる可能性がある。このout-of-bounds readの欠陥は、全世界で30万以上のサーバーに影響を及ぼすとされている。

items.title: JDownloader site hacked to replace installers with Python RAT malware
items.description: The website for the popular JDownloader download manager was compromised earlier this week to distribute malicious Windows and Linux installers, with the Windows payload found deploying a Python-based remote access trojan. [...]
items.tldr: JDownloaderの公式サイトがハッキングされ、WindowsおよびLinux用のインストーラーがマルウェアに置き換えられ、特にWindows用のペイロードはPythonベースのリモートアクセス型トロイの木馬を展開していることが報告されています。

items.title: Fake OpenAI repository on Hugging Face pushes infostealer malware
items.description: A malicious Hugging Face repository that reached the platform's trending list impersonated OpenAI's "Privacy Filter" project to deliver information-stealing malware to Windows users. [...]
items.tldr: Hugging Faceのトレンドリストに登場した悪意のあるリポジトリがOpenAIの「Privacy Filter」プロジェクトを偽装し、Windowsユーザーに情報を盗むマルウェアを配布している。

items.title: cPanel, WHM Release Fixes for Three New Vulnerabilities — Patch Now
items.description: cPanel has released updates to address three vulnerabilities in cPanel and Web Host Manager (WHM) that could be exploited to achieve privilege escalation, code execution, and denial-of-service. The list of vulnerabilities is as follows - CVE-2026-29201 (CVSS score: 4.3) - An insufficient input valid
items.tldr: cPanelは、特権昇格、コード実行、サービス拒否を引き起こす可能性のある3つの脆弱性に対処するための更新をリリースしました。ユーザーは今すぐパッチを適用することが推奨されています。

items.title: Friday Squid Blogging: Giant Squid Live in the Waters of Western Australia
items.description: Evidence of them has been found by analyzing DNA in the seawater. As usual, you can also use this squid post to talk about the security stories in the news that I haven’t covered. Blog moderation policy.
items.tldr: 西オーストラリアの海水中のDNA分析により、巨大イカの存在が確認されました。

items.title: ShinyHunters Claims Second Attack Against Instructure
items.description: The edtech company is struggling to wrest control from its hackers. PII belonging to hundreds of millions of people is on the line.
items.tldr: TL;DR: Edtech企業Instructureがハッカーからの制御を取り戻すのに苦労しており、数億人の個人情報（PII）が危険にさらされています。

items.title: TCLBANKER Banking Trojan Targets Financial Platforms via WhatsApp and Outlook Worms
items.description: Threat hunters have flagged a previously undocumented Brazilian banking trojan dubbed TCLBANKER that's capable of targeting 59 banking, fintech, and cryptocurrency platforms. The activity is being tracked by Elastic Security Labs under the moniker REF3076. The malware family is assessed to be a majo
items.tldr: TL;DR: TCLBANKERという未文書化のブラジルのバンキングトロイの木馬が、WhatsAppやOutlookを介して59の金融プラットフォームを標的にしていることが報告されている。

items.title: Insider Betting on Polymarket
items.description: Insider trading is rife on Polymarket: Analysis by the Anti-Corruption Data Collective, a non-profit research and advocacy group, found that long-shot bets—­defined as wagers of $2,500 or more at odds of 35 percent or less—­on the platform had an average win rate of around 52 percent in
items.tldr: Polymarketではインサイダー取引が横行しており、Anti-Corruption Data Collectiveの分析によると、35％以下のオッズで2,500ドル以上の長期的な賭けは約52％の勝率を持つことが示されています。

items.title: NVIDIA confirms GeForce NOW data breach affecting Armenian users
items.description: NVIDIA has confirmed in a statement for BleepingComputer that GeForce NOW user information has been exposed in a data breach. [...]
items.tldr: NVIDIAは、GeForce NOWのユーザー情報がデータ侵害により流出したことを確認しました。特にアルメニアのユーザーが影響を受けています。

items.title: Fake Call History Apps Stole Payments From Users After 7.3 Million Play Store Downloads
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have discovered fraudulent apps on the official Google Play Store for Android that falsely claimed to offer access to call histories for any phone number, only to trick users into joining a subscription that provided fake data and incurred financial loss. The 28 apps have c
items.tldr: 7.3百万回ダウンロードされたAndroid用の偽の通話履歴アプリが、ユーザーを騙してサブスクリプションに加入させ、偽のデータを提供しながら金銭的損失を引き起こしていたことがサイバーセキュリティ研究者によって発見された。

items.title: Why More Analysts Won’t Solve Your SOC’s Alert Problem
items.description: Attackers move faster than overwhelmed SOC teams can realistically investigate alerts. Prophet Security breaks down how AI can help analysts investigate alerts faster and focus on real threats. [...]
items.tldr: SOCチームのアナリストを増やしても、攻撃者の動きに追いつけず、AIを活用することでアラートの調査を迅速化し、実際の脅威に集中できるようになるとProphet Securityが指摘しています。

items.title: One Click, Total Shutdown: The "Patient Zero" Webinar on Killing Stealth Breaches
items.description: The hardest part of cybersecurity isn't the technology, it’s the people. Every major breach you’ve read about lately usually starts the same way: one employee, one clever email, and one "Patient Zero" infection. In 2026, hackers are using AI to make these "first clicks" nearly impossible to spot. If
items.tldr: サイバーセキュリティの最大の課題は技術ではなく人間であり、最近の大規模な侵害は「Patient Zero」となる従業員の一つのクリックから始まる。2026年には、ハッカーがAIを利用してこの「最初のクリック」を見つけることをほぼ不可能にしている。

items.title: Trellix source code breach claimed by RansomHouse hackers
items.description: The attack on the Trellix source code repository disclosed last week has been claimed by the RansomHouse threat group, which leaked a small set of images as proof of the intrusion. [...]
items.tldr: Trellixのソースコードリポジトリへの攻撃はRansomHouseハッカーグループによって主張され、侵入の証拠として一部の画像が流出しました。

items.title: CISA gives feds four days to patch Ivanti flaw exploited as zero-day
items.description: CISA has given U.S. federal agencies four days to secure their networks against a high-severity vulnerability in Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) exploited in zero-day attacks. [...]
items.tldr: CISAは、Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)の高危険度脆弱性に対処するため、米国連邦機関に4日間の猶予を与えました。この脆弱性はゼロデイ攻撃で悪用されています。

items.title: Quasar Linux RAT Steals Developer Credentials for Software Supply Chain Compromise
items.description: A previously undocumented Linux implant codenamed Quasar Linux RAT (QLNX) is targeting developers' systems to establish a silent foothold as well as facilitate a broad range of post-compromise functionality, such as credential harvesting, keylogging, file manipulation, clipboard monitoring, and netw
items.tldr: TL;DR: Quasar Linux RAT（QLNX）は、開発者のシステムを狙い、認証情報の収集やキーロギング、ファイル操作などの機能を通じてソフトウェアサプライチェーンの侵害を狙う新たなLinuxマルウェアです。

items.title: Zara data breach exposed personal information of 197,000 people
items.description: Hackers who gained access to the databases of Spanish fast-fashion retailer Zara stole data belonging to more than 197,000 customers, according to data breach notification service Have I Been Pwned. [...]
items.tldr: Zaraのデータ侵害により、19万7,000人以上の顧客の個人情報が盗まれたことが報告されている。

items.title: One Missed Threat Per Week: What 25M Alerts Reveal About Low-Severity Risk
items.description: The dark secret of enterprise security operations is that defenders have quietly institutionalized the practice of not looking. This is not just anecdotal, but rather backed by a recent report investigating more than 25 million security alerts, including informational and low-severity, across live e
items.tldr: 企業のセキュリティ運用において、低Severityの警告を無視する慣行が制度化されていることが、2500万件以上のセキュリティアラートを調査した報告によって明らかになった。

items.title: Former govt contractor convicted for wiping dozens of federal databases
items.description: A 34-year-old Virginia man was found guilty of conspiring to destroy dozens of government databases after getting fired from his job as a federal contractor. [...]
items.tldr: 34歳のバージニア州の男性が、連邦契約者としての職を解雇された後、数十の政府データベースを破壊する陰謀で有罪判決を受けた。
